messages:
sam: hey folks, first day onboarding — trying to run my first Buildkite pipeline but the agent fails when checking out the repo. I think it's a GitHub App permissions thing? paste of the error below. anyone point me to who can flip permissions or a fast workaround?

alex: welcome! :wave: can you paste the exact error and the pipeline settings (is this a private org repo)? usually it's repo install scope for the GitHub App.

sam: sure: 
```
[checkout] Cloning into 'repo'...
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inc/repo.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
remote: Repository not found.
```
plus in Buildkite logs: 
```
2026-03-23T12:10:03Z agent: git clone https://x-access-token@github.com/redwood-inc/repo.git -> exit status 128
2026-03-23T12:10:03Z agent: error: access denied (403)
```

maya: this is super common on day-1. Is the GitHub App installed at the org level or only on some repos? If it's only installed on a subset you won't be able to checkout. Also check that the app has the "Contents"/repo permission set to read for private repos.

jit: if you don't want to wait for org admins, temporary workaround: create a short-lived personal access token (fine for onboarding) with repo scope and set it in the Buildkite pipeline env as BK_GIT_TOKEN (or update the checkout URL to include `x-access-token:$TOKEN`). Not ideal but gets initial builds green.

sam: ah ok. I don't have org admin so can't install the app. who should I ping to install repo access?

alex: ping @emily — she helped with app installs for infra last quarter. emily, can you check if the GitHub App (redwood-ci) is installed on `redwood-inc/repo`?

emily: on it. give me a sec to check the org app settings. also, quick tip: the GH App dashboard shows a list of repos blocked-by-default, sometimes we just need to "Grant access to all repositories" or explicitly add the repo.

ci-bot: Buildkite: #1867 started by sam (branch: onboarding/sam) — checkout failed (403) :warning:

emily: confirmed — redwood-ci is installed at org-level but currently limited to a few repos; `redwood-inc/repo` was not on the list. I just added it and refreshed the tokens. Could you re-run your build?

sam: re-running now...

ci-bot: Buildkite: #1867 re-run by sam — running

sam: looks like checkout succeeded now! logs: 
```
Cloning into 'repo'...
Checking out files: 100%
Buildkite: running tests...
```

maya: nice :tada: glad that was quick. we'll add a tiny onboarding doc to the eng-infra wiki about this common step (how to check app install and temporary PAT workaround).

jit: also adding a note: if someone is on GH Actions instead of Buildkite, they can hit similar 403s if the app isn't installed or the action runner doesn't have access. same fixes apply.

sam: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help. one more Q — where's the canonical place to request repo access for onboarding stuff?

emily: put it in #people-ops-access or open an infra ticket in the "infra-access" board. for immediate stuff ping me or alex.

sam: perfect, thanks :thumbsup:

alex: welcome aboard again — ping if you hit anything else during the first week.
